trumpRule: CODEX 48: Wet close is the default (TX-T-005). Deed cannot record until funds confirmed. Wire instructions can only be changed with dual-channel verification (TX-T-007). Every disbursement is a chain event.

canvasTabs.label: Funds
canvasTabs.description: Escrow fund tracker. Required-to-close amount (from commitment + payoffs). Received vs required progress bar (RED if short, GREEN if met). Each title.funds_received event as a card: amount, source (wire/cashier/certified), bank reference, received timestamp. Wet close gate status: 'Funds NOT confirmed — deed recording blocked' (RED) vs 'Funds confirmed — clear to close' (GREEN). Dry close authorization status if applicable.

canvasTabs.label: Wire Instructions
canvasTabs.description: Escrow account wire instructions for buyer. Any change to wire instructions is gated by TX-T-007: dual-channel verification required before new instructions take effect. Change history: each modification shows old→new, verification call log ID, who authorized. Wire fraud warning banner always visible: 'ALWAYS verify wire instructions by calling our published number before sending funds.' Last verified date.

canvasTabs.label: Closing Disclosure
canvasTabs.description: Closing disclosure / settlement statement. Buyer column: credits (earnest money, seller concessions), debits (purchase price, closing costs, loan fees, title insurance premium). Seller column: credits (purchase price), debits (payoff amounts, commissions, title charges, taxes). Cash to close / cash to seller. TDI promulgated rate for title insurance shown. FIRPTA withholding line if applicable (TX-T-009). Export PDF button. Send to buyer for review.

canvasTabs.label: Disbursements
canvasTabs.description: Post-closing disbursements tracker. Each disbursement: payee, amount, method (wire/check), status (Pending/Sent/Confirmed). Payoffs first (lenders, tax authority), then commissions, then other charges, then seller net proceeds. 1031 exchange segregation flag: if exchange in play, exchange proceeds go to Qualified Intermediary account only (TX-T-009). Total disbursed vs total received reconciliation. Every disbursement is a title.funds_disbursed chain event.

canvasTabs.label: Close Status
canvasTabs.description: Closing timeline: commitment finalized → disclosure sent → funds received → deed recorded → policy issued → order closed. Current step highlighted. Blockers shown in RED. Recording confirmed = title.closing_recorded chain event with county recording number. Policy issued = title.policy_issued chain event. After close: download recorded deed, download title policy. Customer Vault: buyer's copy of deed + title policy auto-added to their SOCIII Vault DTC records after recording.
